hint: A big dividend can be broken into pieces that are easy to divide. Look for a piece of $4872$ that is an obvious multiple of $24$.

hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: Notice $24 \times 2 = 48$. So $4800 \div 24 = 200$ exactly. The "extra" $72$ tells you the rest.
A big dividend can be broken into pieces that are easy to divide. Look for a piece of $4872$ that is an obvious multiple of $24$.
Write $4872$ as $4800 + 72$. Divide each part by $24$ on its own, then add the two quotients. Check whether anything is left over.

explanation: Break the dividend into friendly parts that $24$ divides easily: $4872 = 4800 + 72$.
Since $24 \times 2 = 48$, it follows that $24 \times 200 = 4800$, so the first part gives $4800 \div 24 = 200$.
For the leftover part, use the fact that $24 \times 3 = 72$, so $72 \div 24 = 3$.
Add the partial quotients: $200 + 3 = 203$. The remainder is $0$, so no decimal digits are needed and the answer is $203$.
